title: cmd/server coverage improved from 0.0% to 2.1% — main() entry path still untested
description: The buildServer() helper is now tested (2 tests, covering 2.1% of statements). However main() itself — including PORT/DB_DSN/LOG_LEVEL env-var defaulting, server startup goroutine, signal handling, and graceful shutdown — remains entirely untested. These paths cover the majority of application lifecycle logic.
recommended_action: Extract configuration parsing into a testable function; add integration tests using httptest.NewServer for the startup path; use os.Pipe or a channel-based approach to simulate signal handling

title: Method-not-allowed tests cover only POST and DELETE
description: Tests verify 405 for POST (line 41) and DELETE (line 222) only. HTTP methods PUT, PATCH, and HEAD are not tested for the method-not-allowed contract. The 405 behaviour is under-specified in the test suite.
recommended_action: Use table-driven tests iterating over []string{http.MethodPost, http.MethodPut, http.MethodPatch, http.MethodDelete} and asserting HTTP 405 for each on all relevant handlers

title: HealthHandler json.Encoder error branch has 0% coverage
description: HealthHandler (added during remediation) has the same json.Encoder error guard pattern as OrdersHandler, but no test exercises this error path. Unlike OrdersHandler which gained TestOrdersHandler_EncoderError, HealthHandler's HTTP 500 error branch is unreachable with the current test suite.
recommended_action: Add TestHealthHandler_EncoderError using the same failingWriter pattern as TestOrdersHandler_EncoderError to verify HTTP 500 on encode failure

title: ReadinessHandler json.Encoder error branch has 0% coverage
description: ReadinessHandler's json.Encoder error guard (added during remediation of CQ-001) has never been executed by any test. The error path is unreachable with a standard httptest.ResponseRecorder. While the HealthHandler has the same gap (TC-009), ReadinessHandler's gap pre-dates the remediation cycle.
recommended_action: Add TestReadinessHandler_EncoderError using the failingWriter pattern to verify HTTP 500 on encode failure, consistent with TestOrdersHandler_EncoderError
